Results.ReviewText: I've never owned a large grill before I purchased the "Original Kettle Charcoal Grill 22 inch". I have had two "Smokey Joe's" prior to this purchase and really enjoyed them for over 28 years each. Now I can smoke/cook for our family get togethers with much more ease, instead of having to smoke/cook several items one at a time. I love the smell and taste of charcoal; I also start my charcoal with the Weber tower charcoal starter and get cooking faster without the mess and smell of dangerous charcoal lighter in my food. Thank you for a great product for over 28 years of cooking on my Weber charcoal grills. As a side note: I still have a small collection of the printed Weber grilling newsletters (I can't remember what they were called) that were mailed every month after purchasing my first Smokey Joe in 1991. Thanks again!
Results.Title: Amazing long lasting charcoal grill!

Results.ReviewText: Weber not only makes some of the best grills, the also have THE BEST customer service of any company.

Results.ReviewText: OK full disclosure here. I didn't buy a new 22" grill. I was gifted one that was well over several years old. The charcoal and cooking grates were broken, rusted and deformed and the one touch ash removal fins were inoperable. The ash pan was also beat up pretty bad. I was able to get new Weber parts that fit exactly and touched up some dings and dents with a hammer and some hi-temp paint. It works great now and I'm looking forward to many more years of making great tasting food on the kettle!

Results.ReviewText: My kettle grill is about fifty years old.  I porcelain finish is still fine.  Why I say that is, I do not use lighter fluid.  I light my lump charcoal with a 500,000 btu weed torch.  There is no need to wait twenty minutes for charcoal to be white.  Two minutes with my weed torch and the charcoal is ready to start grilling or roasting.  If I am roasting I still use the two Weber charcoal holder for indirect roasting.  About one minute on each holder with my weed torch and ready to start roasting.  With all that heat (flame) the porcelain Is holding up fine.
Results.Title: Simply the Best

Results.ReviewText: I had bought the Weber grill on Amazon.  When I tried to put it together the parts did not fit. The replacement parts fit like a glove. I am so please with your support and this continues to keep me buying your products.  Thans you again.

741001.Description: Stay true to the modern version of the kettle that started it all—the Original Kettle®, invented by Weber’s founder, and loved around the world. Its ultra-durable, porcelain-enameled lid and bowl retain heat, while the dampers easily adjust for precise temperature control. With a One-Touch™ cleaning system for easy cleanup after a long day of grilling, the Original Kettle® will always be the grill built for everyone.•	 Holds up to 13 burgers made with a Weber burger press•	 One-Touch™ cleaning system provides hassle-free ash cleanup•	 Porcelain-enameled lid and bowl retain heat, and won’t rust or peel•	 Use the lid hook to avoid placing the lid on the ground while grilling•	 Dampers allow you to easily control the temperature inside your grill•	 Durable plated steel cooking grate retains heat and is easy to clean
